meta.title: Link Bank Accounts in One App | Open Banking
meta.description: Open Banking allows you to link your bank accounts for full visibility of your finances — all in one convenient place.

content.caption: Linked accounts
content.title: All accounts, accounted for
content.description: Link your external accounts to Revolut for a full and secure view of your money, all in one app.

items.title: A 360° view of your money
items.description: Get a complete overview of all your finances, all in one place, so you can manage your money without switching apps. Connect in seconds, and drop the juggling act.
items.caption: Balance overview

items.title: Every payment, managed
items.description: Track your upcoming subscriptions, Direct Debits, and recurring payments, wherever you’re paying from. Move money between accounts smoothly, so it’s exactly where you need it.
items.caption: Manage payments

content.title: Your spend, analysed
content.description: Track analytics across all your linked accounts, to see your spending trends — and navigate your finances with ease.

content.title: 150 banks, 21 countries
content.description: Connect a range of account types from around the globe. From current to credit, get eyes on every penny, cent, or dollar spent.

content.title: Your money, protected
content.description: Trusted with 67.5 billion USD in customer funds — our cutting-edge security features, and award-winning customer support, helped prevent more than £632 million worth of fraud globally in 2024 alone.

Revolut Bank UK Ltd is registered in England and Wales (Registered No. 12871051). Registered address: 30 South Colonnade, London, E14 5HX. Authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and Prudential Regulation Authority (Financial Services Register No. 981170).

Revolut Ltd is registered in England and Wales (No. 08804411), is authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority to offer e-money and payment services under the Electronic Money Regulations 2011 (FRN: 900562), and is registered with the Financial Conduct Authority to offer cryptocurrency services under the Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing and Transfer of Funds (Information on the Payer) Regulations 2017. Commodities services are provided by Revolut Ltd and are not regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

Investment services are provided by Revolut Trading Ltd (No. 11567840), which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FRN: 933846).

The registered address of Revolut Ltd, Revolut Travel Ltd, and Revolut Trading Ltd is at 30 South Colonnade, London, United Kingdom, E14 5HX. You can read more about our terms and policies here.
